scope: Read-only provenance/source inventory and a proposed minimum paper-relevant realization partition. This is not an SRP.2 eligibility verdict, synthesis run, physical realization, PPA result, or performance claim.

prior_navigation_snapshot.meaning: the pre-SRP document-map snapshot; it is not substituted for the SRP source snapshot

srp_source_inventory.meaning: exact source/document snapshot used by this SRP.0 inventory

chisel_build.observation: The checked build declares Chisel and ScalaTest only. No selected synthesis executable, target library, macro/black-box implementation, clock constraint, or PDK is recorded.

primary_rtl3_9_c4_witness.role: test-only composed C3b/C4 success, negative-event, and replay witness; never a production or synthesis-top source

discovery_limits: The main source declares structural Chisel modules; SRP.0 does not infer that every structurally instantiated module is a complete functional or synthesis-ready implementation.

No main-source BlackBox, emitted-Verilog, selected synthesis, PDK, macro, or timing-constraint flow was found by the recorded source search. A test imports ChiselStage for structural elaboration only; that is not synthesis evidence.

structural_top_inventory.top_role: composition-only skeleton with inactive carriers; inventory root only, not the proposed future synthesis top
structural_top_inventory.interpretation: This list is a structural source inventory. The C4-D functional result is established by named same-instance test witnesses and outer functional environments, not by treating this list as a synthesis-complete top.

partition_records.proposal: Define a future synthesis top from selected control/wrapper boundaries; do not reuse the current composition skeleton as evidence.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Port-level selection and regression plan are required after the SRP.1 human review.

partition_records.proposal: Retain the owner-correct lifecycle/authority/terminal/drain control as a future DUT candidate, with common versus Route-A path activity separated per operation.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Preserve authority conservation, exactly-one terminal, global retirement membership, reset, and retire acknowledgement assertions.

partition_records.architecture_owner: R2 arbitration and R1 core-memory boundary
partition_records.proposal: Candidate core control remains separate from the external memory/controller/CDC contract. Charge only Route-A differential operations, not the entire shared R1/R2 provision.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Preserve one R2-to-R1 path, identity/fragment/reset/stale handling, credit nonmutation, and descriptor/payload/sidecar routing semantics.

partition_records.architecture_owner: R3 retained-record materialization and publication control
partition_records.proposal: Keep materialization, immutable member association, packing prerequisites, and publication control in the minimum Route-A candidate boundary. The already-selected admission/predictor decision stays external.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Preserve payload/descriptor durability prerequisites, one metadata publication, all-member R6 acceptance before packed use, and no second authority owner.

partition_records.proposal: M2 control/interface is paper-relevant; the named reference protocol provider is not a selected physical M2 implementation and must remain an external/reference artifact.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Future storage realization must preserve exact group/member round trips and publication provenance without replacing the immutable ledger with a second authority table.

partition_records.proposal: Keep logical P3 control distinct from pending-HBM authoritative backing and the unphysicalized p3_payload_stage_page. Neither backing nor stage payload storage may be silently synthesized as a large register array.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: A later realization choice must preserve R1 durability, generation/sidecar association, and the declared core-side memory contract.

partition_records.architecture_owner: R5 allocator, descriptor visibility, and per-page reclaim
partition_records.proposal: Treat allocator/reclaim control, on-chip availability state, and separate descriptor-HBM region as distinct realization items.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Preserve descriptor visibility only in publication, durable invalidation before free, generation/quiescence, and R6-before-R5 retirement order.

partition_records.proposal: S2 payload/GQA provision is shared and must be reported once; Route-A position sidecar and its management are incremental. The functional sidecar-delivery adapter is not a physical sidecar implementation.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Preserve slot identity/generation, READY only after payload and sidecar completion, four consumer commits before release, and stale exclusion.

partition_records.proposal: The source-association and multi-source merge-support control is a Route-A implementation candidate, separate from numeric arithmetic.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Preserve canonical source association, accepted packet identity/consumer association, four commits, and terminal/fault handoff to R6.

partition_records.proposal: Binary32 observable behavior is frozen, but exp/internal precision, partial-state storage/spill, and pipeline realization are not selected. The current functional R4 reference is external/verification-only.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: A separate numeric-realization decision must preserve result/fault contract and one R6 terminal; it may not use the reference provider as a DUT surrogate.

partition_records.proposal: Complete attention MAC/PE/RoPE implementation is excluded from the Route-A DUT. Its explicit interface and any route-specific activity effect require a declared evaluation-system contract.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Functional partial packets remain an outer environment and may not become a storage-owner computation path.

partition_records.proposal: HBM controller/PHY/CDC is excluded from local implementation, but its Route-A differential service/cost evidence cannot be omitted. core_mem_if_v1 is not an HBM protocol or burst selection.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: A later calibrated service/memory-wrapper evidence plan must retain the frozen core-side request/response contract and stale/fault behavior.

source: C3b/C4 accepted-event observers and replay oracles
partition_records.proposal: No test-scope fixture, observer, event adapter, replay oracle, or C4 harness may enter the future synthesis DUT or create an owner/cost claim.
partition_records.replacement_or_evidence: Retain them only as regressions that check owner-produced handshakes and frozen semantic properties.

must_have_implementation_or_credible_cos: Route-A R3/R5 packing, publication, descriptor, allocator, and reclaim control
Route-A M2/P3 control plus a non-zero realization route for their storage/backing
Route-A S2 sidecar and page-management increment, while retaining common S2 cost separation
Route-A structural R4 merge-support control and a credible numeric/partial-state evidence route
Route-A differential use of shared R1/R2/R6 and external memory service
explicit_local_implementation_exclusions: HBM controller, PHY, and CDC implementation
testbench-only functional memories, fixtures, observers, and replay oracles
minimum_paper_boundary_proposal.not_yet_approved: The exact future synthesis-top member list and each implementation/wrapper choice remain pending human review.

semantic_regression_obligations: identity, incarnation/generation, reset, stale-response, and fault exclusion
all-member R6 acceptance before first packed read and S2 READY after exact payload/sidecar completion
four GQA consumer commits before source release and exactly one R6 terminal
durable invalidation/reclaim before page free and final R6 retire acknowledgement
stop_for_review: A current composition-only skeleton cannot be called the synthesis top without an approved selected boundary.
M2, P3 stage/pending backing, R5 descriptor/availability, and S2 sidecar each require distinct storage/interface realization requirements.
R4 numeric/partial-state realization lacks a selected implementation or cost model.
No selected synthesis toolchain/library/black-box/macro/clock-constraint flow exists in the checked source tree.
Full-KV common provision and Route-A differential activity must be reconciled before any whole-module cost attribution.
next_gate: Human review of this SRP.0--SRP.1 partition proposal. SRP.2 source/toolchain eligibility does not begin automatically.
